_doc: Revert-verify mutants for RFC 14217015 P1.3 (vault-exodev task 2038636f, req ebbe3db4): NoteToRDFConverter materializes the logical edge of a reified statement whose class is a SUBCLASS of exo__Statement, by a bounded (16 hops), cycle-guarded walk of exo__Class_superClass over class-file frontmatter, run only after the three statement slots resolved and the exact exo#Statement match failed. Each mutant removes one guard and must redden exactly the axes in `expect`; no two mutants share a set (§A147). S3 (negative axis) and S4/S9/S10 are green on the pre-fix base by design — S3 is the negative axis, S9 the unchanged exact-Statement control, S4/S10 guard behaviour the base never exercised. S9 carries no mutant: it is a control of the PRE-EXISTING exact-match path, and dropping that loop check is now an equivalent mutant (the walk identifies exo__Statement through its class file at depth 0). The `!isReifiedStmt` conjunct of the walk gate carries no mutant: dropping it walks an exact exo__Statement, whose identity check returns true at depth 0 — an equivalent mutant (cost only). `red_re` anchors on the jest failure header (§A104). `tree`/`subject` are placeholders — run the matrix on a copy with the paths substituted (§A145).

M2_identity_ignores_class_file_label._note: A bare-UID superClass ref is identified only through the class file's exo__Asset_label; dropping it loses exo__Statement wherever it is referenced by UID (the vault's dominant form).

M3_cycle_guard_removed._note: Without the visited set a cycle is stopped only by the depth cap, which warns.

M4_cap_one_hop_too_loose._note: `>` instead of `>=` lets the 17th hop through — the over-cap chain then gives the edge and no warning.

M5_cap_one_hop_too_tight._note: The other side of the boundary: a chain of exactly 16 hops must still give the edge.

M6_no_disk_fallback._note: On a cold plugin cache only the asset's direct class is pre-warmed; the grandparents are reachable through getFrontmatterWithFallback alone.

M7_cap_warning_removed._note: Reaching the cap must be reported, not silent.

M8_own_class_identity_skipped._note: The asset's OWN classes are identity-checked too: an exact exo__Statement emitted as the class FILE IRI (emitInstanceClassAsUid) fails the loop's symbolic comparison and is recognised only here.

M9_any_class_counts_as_statement._note: The walk must recognise exo__Statement, not any identified class: a non-statement class carrying the slots then gives an edge. Written as a prefix test (every symbolic class IRI is https) rather than `identity !== null`, which narrows `identity` to never below and breaks compilation (§A36). S5b/S5c redden too, and legitimately: the over-cap chain's classes carry prefix-form labels (test__Chain0…), so the mutant returns true at depth 0 — the edge appears and the cap (and its warning) is never reached.
